source(output(
		MEME_CK as integer,
		GROUP_CK as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		USER_ID as long,
		EFF_DATE as integer,
		EFF_TIME as integer,
		TERM_DATE as integer,
		TERM_TIME as integer,
		ANSWER as string,
		TERMDate_Change as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'exec [APP_CAEDM].[PR_U_MEMBER_CONCEPT_ETL]  		@THREAD_GROUP = ?, 		@NO_OF_BATCHES = ?, 		@BATCH_NUMBER = ?, 		@INC_UMCV = 1, 		@INC_UMCVL = 1, 		@CID_BEG=?, 		@CID_END=?,                                       @DELTA=?,                                       @UPDATE_TIME=? WITH RESULT SETS (  (  MEME_CK  INT, GROUP_CK INT,	 CONCEPT_ID INT, ANSWER VARCHAR(4000),	 USER_ID INT, EFF_DATE INT, EFF_TIME INT,		 TERM_DATE INT, TERM_TIME INT,	  TERMDate_Change INT  )  )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ExecutePRUMEMBERCONCEPTETLonConnectionCAERPTUTILA01	source(output(
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		CONCEPT_KEY as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     ddc.CONCEPT_ID,     MIN(ddc.CONCEPT_KEY) CONCEPT_KEY FROM     APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT ddc WITH (NOLOCK)  JOIN     APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER_CONCEPT_LOOKUP ddmcl   WITH (NOLOCK)  ON ddc.CONCEPT_ID = ddmcl.CONCEPT_ID  GROUP BY     ddc.CONCEPT_ID ORDER BY ddc.CONCEPT_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE
ExecutePRUMEMBERCONCEPTETLonConnectionCAERPTUTILA01,LookupCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE lookup(ExecutePRUMEMBERCONCEPTETLonConnectionCAERPTUTILA01@CONCEPT_ID == LookupCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE@CONCEPT_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupCONCEPTKEY
LookupCONCEPTKEY select(mapColumn(
		MEME_CK = MEME_CK,
		GROUP_CK = GROUP_CK,
		CONCEPT_ID = ExecutePRUMEMBERCONCEPTETLonConnectionCAERPTUTILA01@CONCEPT_ID,
		USER_ID = USER_ID,
		EFF_DATE = EFF_DATE,
		EFF_TIME = EFF_TIME,
		TERM_DATE = TERM_DATE,
		TERM_TIME = TERM_TIME,
		ANSWER = ANSWER,
		TERMDate_Change = TERMDate_Change,
		CONCEPT_KEY = CONCEPT_KEY
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupCONCEPTKEYSelect
LookupCONCEPTKEYSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupCONCEPTKEYIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupCONCEPTKEYIsMatch@Match split(TermDate_Change == 0, disjoint: true) ~> ConSplitforTERMDATEupdate@(TERMDATE,TERMDATE2099)
ConSplitforTERMDATEupdate@TERMDATE sink(input(
		CONCEPT_KEY as integer,
		ANSWER as string,
		TERM_DATE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		MEME_CK as integer,
		EFF_DATE as integer,
		TERM_TIME as integer,
		GROUP_CK as integer,
		EFF_TIME as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_KEY,
		ANSWER,
		TERM_DATE,
		USER_ID,
		MEME_CK,
		EFF_DATE,
		TERM_TIME,
		GROUP_CK,
		EFF_TIME)) ~> TargetA01
ConSplitforTERMDATEupdate@TERMDATE2099 sink(input(
		CONCEPT_KEY as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		TERM_DATE as integer,
		USER_ID as long,
		MEME_CK as integer,
		EFF_DATE as integer,
		TERM_TIME as integer,
		GROUP_CK as integer,
		EFF_TIME as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_KEY,
		CONCEPT_ID,
		TERM_DATE,
		USER_ID,
		MEME_CK,
		EFF_DATE,
		TERM_TIME,
		GROUP_CK,
		EFF_TIME)) ~> DSTTERMDATESTAGE
